DEPARTMENT OF CARDIOLOGY

ECHOCARDIOGRAPHY WITH COLOUR DOPPLER

 

M-MODE & 2 D MEASUREMENTS

 

 

 

IMPRESSION :-

 

             * Situs solitus.Ventriculo atrial and ventriculo vascular concordance present.

             * Normally related great arteris.

             * Normal sized cardiac chambers.

             * No regional wall motion abnormality.

             * Good Bi-ventricular systolic function.

             * Left ventricular ejection fraction of about       %.

             * All four cardiac valves are normal in appearance and motion.

             * No pulmonary arterial hypertension.

             * No intra-cardiac shunt or mass.

             * No pericardium pathology. 

 

 

DOPPLER STUDY :-

 

             * No significant AR/MR/TR/PR.

             * No significant gradient across the semilunar valves.
